title: A Situational Speech Synthesizer for Yoruba: System Design, Phonological Rule Architecture, and Orthographic Extensions for Contour
abstract: arXiv:2607.18317v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present TTSYoruba, a rule-based concatenative diphone speech synthesizer for Yoruba, deployed at online as part of the YorubaName.com open dictionary of Yoruba personal names. The system takes tone-marked Yoruba text as input and produces audio output by applying a hand-crafted phonological rule system to a recorded inventory of 651 diphone units spanning five tonal variants of every consonant-vowel combination in the language. translated_title: 面向约鲁巴语的情境语音合成器：系统设计、音系规则架构与声调轮廓的正字法扩展
translated_abstract: 我们提出了TTSYoruba，一个基于规则的约鲁巴语双音素拼接式语音合成器，作为YorubaName.com约鲁巴人名开放词典的组成部分在线部署。该系统以带声调标记的约鲁巴语文本为输入，通过将手工构建的音系规则系统应用于录制的651个双音素单元库来生成音频输出，这些单元涵盖了该语言中所有辅音-元音组合的五种声调变体。我们详细描述了该系统的音系架构，包括完整的声调文件选择逻辑、对三重鼻音歧义问题（口部音/n/、鼻化元音和音节鼻音）的处理方法，以及从平声输入推导语境中升调和降调的方法。作为正字法层面的贡献，我们还提出采用扬抑符（caron）和长音符（circumflex）——这些符号在约鲁巴语音系转写中已有使用先例——作为标准的单元音声调轮廓标记。
tldr: 本文提出了TTSYoruba，一个基于规则的双音素拼接式约鲁巴语语音合成器，其核心创新在于手工构建的音系规则架构（涵盖声调文件选择逻辑、三重鼻音歧义消解以及从平声推导升降调），并提出采用扬抑符和长音符作为单元音声调轮廓的标准正字法符号。
en_tdlr: This paper presents TTSYoruba, a rule-based concatenative diphone speech synthesizer for Yoruba, whose key contributions include a hand-crafted phonological rule architecture covering tonal file-selection logic, three-way nasal disambiguation, and contextual rising/falling tone derivation, together with an orthographic extension adopting the caron and circumflex as standard single-vowel contour tone marks.
